rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a reporting duty for an event that applies only to persons with a stated insurance status and only when a stated outcome holds, and this duty is independent of an earlier report of the same event: Model each criterion that limits the duty as its own exclusive gateway, with a yes/no question worded from the description, placed before the reporting task. Place the reporting task only on the branch where all criteria hold, keep it as a separate task rather than merging it into the earlier report, and join the branches before the next common step. If several such reports must all be completed, open them from a parallel gateway and close them with a second parallel gateway before the next common step.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a reporting duty for an event that applies only to persons with a stated insurance status and only when a stated outcome holds, and this duty is independent of an earlier report of the same event
